column1: # Campestrini M., Rabino F., Marques D., Atig D., Stringari P., Franzoni G., Picutti B. (2022).
# Experimental investigation of the effect of nitrogen on the phase equilibrium behavior of the CH4-CO2 mixture
# at low temperature for natural and biogas purification. Fluid Phase Equilibria 553, 113292.
# DOI 10.1016/j.fluid.2021.113292. Source copy: HAL hal-03519082 (author manuscript, CC BY-NC 4.0),
# Tables 4 (p.14, SVE, CH4 + CO2), 6 (p.18, SLE, CH4 + CO2), 7 and 8 (p.20, SVE and SLE, solvent B = 5 % N2 + 95 % CH4),
# 9 and 10 (p.21, SVE and SLE, solvent C = 10 % N2 + 90 % CH4), 12 (p.27, SLVE, solvents B and C); page numbers are the
# manuscript's printed numbers. Tables 5 and 11 (VLE, no solid) are not transcribed.
# Units: T in K, p in MPa, compositions in mole fraction. U = expanded uncertainty as printed (the text calls them
# "expanded and combined standard uncertainties"); U(T) = 0.004 K and U(P) = 0.002 MPa for every point (table footers).
# phase: vapor (y) or liquid (x). For SVE rows the solid CO2 coexists with the vapor, for SLE rows with the liquid,
# for SLVE rows with both. Nominal pressure 4 MPa, 170 to 210 K.
# Table 12 of the manuscript prints no x1 or y1 (N2) columns, only U(x1) and U(y1); the N2 value is therefore blank here
# (it is 1 - CH4 - CO2 by closure, not transcribed). Points marked (1) in Table 12 (78 to 81, 85, 88) have no liquid sample:
# "the amount of the liquid phase within the equilibrium cell was not enough developed to be sampled".
# Digits verbatim from the PyMuPDF text layer; Tables 7, 8 and 12 were checked against a 140-170 dpi page render.
# Transcribed 2026-09-25 for batch 2026-09-24-coolprop-low-temperature (P5/G5 holdout; SVE rows also P4 context).
